answer: I'd like to talk about a small gadget that I carry with me almost everywhere. A gadget I find genuinely helpful in daily life is a pair of wireless earphones I bought a while ago. They might seem like a small thing, but they have become surprisingly [[indispensable]]. They connect to my phone by Bluetooth as soon as I take them out of their little charging case, and a single tap on either earbud lets me pause music or answer a call. The case recharges them whenever I put them back, so one full charge usually lasts me several days. I use them constantly, whether I am commuting, exercising or simply trying to concentrate on work. I'd say I wear them for at least two or three hours every day, including on my evening walks by the river. What makes them so useful is the freedom they offer; without any wires, I can move around completely [[unhindered]]. They also block out background noise, which is a real blessing on our busy streets, where rickshaw bells and horns never seem to stop. I honestly appreciate how such a compact device can make everyday tasks so much more pleasant. Listening to music or podcasts during my commute has transformed what used to be a tedious part of my day. It is a perfect example of a small piece of technology that is genuinely [[practical]] rather than just a [[gimmick]]. Honestly, I would replace them immediately if they broke. I think the best gadgets are the ones you barely notice using, because they have become so [[seamlessly]] woven into your routine.

followUps.q: Do you ever worry about using earphones too much?
followUps.answer: A little, yes. I try to keep the volume moderate and take them out when I'm walking along busy roads, because it's important to stay aware of rickshaws and traffic around me.

followUps.q: What other gadget would you like to buy?
followUps.answer: Perhaps an e-reader. I read a lot, and it would be handy on long bus journeys to Dhaka, since carrying several books at once is rather [[cumbersome]].

note: Moved plain-ish mark 'pleasant' to 'unhindered'; 'noisy city' localised to busy streets with rickshaws; added how they work (bullet 2) and daily usage; new mark 'gimmick'.
